settings.title: Directions for Use
settings.content:
1. Cleanse and tone your skin.
  2. Remove the hydrogel mask and smooth it flat onto clean, dry skin.
  3. Wear for 3–4 hours for an intensive treatment, or leave on overnight as a sleeping mask.
  4. The mask turns transparent when done — peel off gently.
  5. Pat in any remaining essence. No rinsing needed.

settings.title: Key Ingredients
settings.content:
• Ultra-low molecular collagen – deep penetration, firming, pore-refining
  • Oligo-hyaluronic acid – multi-layer hydration
  • Niacinamide – brightening, evens skin tone
  • 3 Probiotics (Lactobacillus, Bifida ferments) – strengthens skin barrier
  • Galactomyces ferment filtrate – improves texture & glow

settings.question: How long should I leave the mask on?
settings.answer: 3–4 hours for an intensive treatment, or leave on overnight as a sleeping mask. The hydrogel turns transparent when it's fully absorbed.

settings.question: Do I need to rinse my face after?
settings.answer: Nope! Just peel off the mask gently and pat any remaining essence into your skin. No rinsing required.

settings.question: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes. The formula is dermatologist-tested and free from 19 harsh, allergy-causing ingredients including alcohol, parabens, and artificial fragrance. We recommend a patch test for first-time use.

settings.question: How often can I use it?
settings.answer: 2–3 times a week is ideal for visible results. If your skin is very dry or dehydrated, it's safe to use nightly.

settings.question: What are the shipping timelines?
settings.answer: We deliver across India in 3–7 working days. Metro cities usually receive orders within 2–4 days. You'll get tracking via SMS & email.
